results.name: Soulbreaker
results.description: Punch the enemy in the chest, dash behind them, lift them, and slam them into the earth.

results.name: Grave Driver
results.description: Sweep the legs, seize an ankle, swing the enemy overhead, and hammer them into the ground.

results.name: Crown of Ruin
results.description: Launch the enemy with an uppercut, leap after them, and drive a spinning heel through their guard.

results.name: Hell’s Guillotine
results.description: Fold the enemy with a knee, vault above them, then bring a straight axe kick down onto them.

results.name: Tyrant’s Verdict
results.description: Catch the enemy’s wrist, cast them outward, step beside the fallen body and drive a crushing heel into their leg.

results.name: Furnace Heart
results.description: Plant a burning palm against the chest, ignite the mark, and kick the enemy away as it detonates.

results.name: Cinder Spiral
results.description: Sweep the enemy down, clamp an ankle, backpedal around a burning ring while their body scrapes the ground, then swing and release them.

results.name: Infernal Pillar
results.description: Brand the chest, raise the victim in a fire column, then command a violent downward burial with both hands.

results.name: Meteor Burial
results.description: Launch the enemy skyward, pursue them, then hurl their burning body diagonally into the earth.

results.name: Ashen Cross
results.description: Carve two blazing claw trails across the enemy, then snap both arms outward to trigger crossfire.

results.name: Pyre King
results.description: Kick the enemy to their knees, brand their forehead, and close three fire rings around them.

results.name: Mindbreaker
results.description: Grip both temples, suspend the enemy, then release a focused psychic pulse that folds them to the floor.

results.name: Gravity Coffin
results.description: Suspend the enemy inside a floating psychic cage, compress it from six sides, and drive it into the ground.

results.name: Orbit of Ruin
results.description: Tether the enemy to your hand, swing them around your body, and whip them into a distant ground impact.

results.name: Heaven’s Rejection
results.description: Flick the enemy straight into the sky, hold them motionless for a beat, and pull them violently back down.

results.name: Rift Fold
results.description: Open opposing psychic planes, fold the enemy through them behind you, and slam them sideways.

results.name: Wraith Procession
results.description: Summon three doubles to strike from different angles, then dash through their wake for the final palm slam.

results.name: Soul Sever
results.description: Hook the enemy with a spectral claw, pull an ethereal double from their body, and snap the connecting tether.

results.name: Pale Requiem
results.description: Pass through the enemy, raise their spectral echo above them, then drag echo and body into the ground together.

results.name: Tomb of Echoes
results.description: Bind the enemy’s wrists and ankles with spectral chains, circle them with apparitions, and collapse the bindings.

results.name: Kingbreaker
results.description: Break the king’s stance, seize his lowered head, drive in a knee, hammer him to the floor, and wrench the crown free before the final throw.

results.name: Throne of Cinders
results.description: Sweep the giant down, seize an ankle, drag its body around a burning ring, swing it down, then crush it with successive stamping blows.

results.name: Sovereign’s Ruin
results.description: Force the sovereign to kneel, lock both temples, release it into psychic suspension, compress its body in successive pulses, and rip the crown away as gravity returns.

results.name: Ribsunder
results.description: Left rib → Right rib → Elbow collapse.

results.name: Black Anvil
results.description: Break the stance → Raise both fists → Anvil blow.

results.name: Spinewheel
results.description: Catch the wrist → Wheel to the flank → Heel verdict.

results.name: Hornfall
results.description: Crown capture → Driving knee → Cast the horns down.

results.name: Ruinmaker
results.description: Draw the arm → Shoulder rupture → Stamp the ruin.

results.name: Crucible Hook
results.description: Burning hook → Lift through flame → Crucible drop.

results.name: Dragon’s Wake
results.description: Flank the guard → Exhale the furnace → Burning backfist.

results.name: Ember Pendulum
results.description: Low brand → Pendulum heel → Crescent heel crush.

results.name: Searing Brand
results.description: Sternum brand → Draw the fire → Brand eruption.

results.name: Ashfall
results.description: Launch the offering → Bend the flame → Ashfall.

results.name: Hellmouth
results.description: Circle the condemned → Open the pit → Seal with both palms.

results.name: Vector Break
results.description: Left vector → Right vector → Terminal vector.

results.name: Neural Guillotine
results.description: Temple lock → Turn the thought → Mind severance.

results.name: Event Horizon
results.description: Raise the orbit → Invert the captive → Collapse the horizon.

results.name: Oblivion Press
results.description: Crush the knees → Suspend the weight → Oblivion.

results.name: Thought Spear
results.description: Pin the mind → Draw the spear → Pierce and release.

results.name: Widow’s Passage
results.description: Veil the flank → Rear claw → Widow’s mercy.

results.name: Reaper’s Toll
results.description: Mark the soul → Reel the debt → Collect the toll.

results.name: Nightfall Covenant
results.description: Summon the witnesses → Bind the vow → Seal the covenant.

results.name: Last Procession
results.description: First witness → Second witness → Final witness.

results.name: Titan’s Reckoning
results.description: Rake the shin → Break the guard → Crown clamp → Driving knee → Raise the hammer → The reckoning.

results.name: Sunless Coronation
results.description: Break the knees → Brand the brow → Raise the pyre → Crown with fire → Rise above → Extinguish the king.

results.name: World’s End
results.description: Shatter the stance → Seize the mind → Raise the giant → Reverse its orbit → Hold the world → End its weight.
